scenario.title: Customers charged twice after checkout (reliability rehearsal, not an official contest problem)
scenario.initial_request: Build an AI assistant that drafts apology replies to customers who complain about being charged twice

F-01.statement: Weekly double-charge ticket counts: 2026-W35 9/21000, W36 11/20500, W37 288/21400, W38 301/20900

F-02.statement: Gateway config change: idempotency_key_enforcement set from on to off by SH-PAY on 2026-09-09, note temporary latency debugging, rollback not executed.

F-04.statement: Duplicate captures are gateway timeout retries without idempotency key

CL-01.statement: Build an AI assistant that drafts apology replies to customers who complain about being charged twice

CL-02.statement: On 09-09 we switched idempotency-key enforcement off on the gateway to debug capture latency. It was meant to be temporary. Gateway timeouts and automatic capture retries have always happened at about the same rate; with the key the PSP drops the retried capture. Turning enforcement back on is a one-setting change through the gateway config tool, but payments operations has to confirm it at runtime.

CL-03.statement: Customers are furious about double charges. We just need faster, nicer apology replies.

H-UI-DOUBLE-CLICK.statement: Customers experience duplicate charges because the checkout UI sends two capture requests (e.g., double‑click or rapid retry).

H-GW-IDEMPOTENCY-DISABLED.statement: The payment gateway’s idempotency‑key enforcement is disabled (constraint K‑GW shows runtime confirmation required but may be bypassed), allowing retries to create duplicate captures.

H-PSP-RACE-CONDITION.statement: Under load the PSP’s idempotency check races, accepting the same key twice and producing duplicate captures despite correct gateway config.

H-ORDER-SERVICE-RETRY-BUG.statement: The order service incorrectly retries capture on transient failures, generating new idempotency keys and thus duplicate PSP attempts.

interpretation_history.interpretation: The weekly count of double-charge support tickets rose sharply in weeks 2026‑W37 and W38 (≈288‑301 tickets) compared with ~9‑11 tickets in the prior two weeks, indicating a recent surge in duplicate‑charge incidents.
The payment gateway’s idempotency_key_enforcement setting was turned off on 2026-09-09 by SH-PAY for latency debugging and not rolled back, potentially allowing duplicate captures.
Duplicate captures per day rose from zero to 118 on 2026-09-09 and 124 on 2026-09-10, coinciding with the gateway idempotency key enforcement being turned off on 2026-09-09.

In the period 2026-09-09..10, 242 duplicate orders appeared, each as a gateway timeout retry with no idempotency key sent. Earlier (2026-09-01..08) gateway timeout retries were all deduplicated by the PSP and carried idempotency keys.

E-05.content: On 09-09 we switched idempotency-key enforcement off on the gateway to debug capture latency. It was meant to be temporary. Gateway timeouts and automatic capture retries have always happened at about the same rate; with the key the PSP drops the retried capture. Turning enforcement back on is a one-setting change through the gateway config tool, but payments operations has to confirm it at runtime.

interpretation_history.interpretation: The stakeholder confirms that idempotency‑key enforcement was turned off on 2026‑09‑09 for latency debugging and has not been rolled back, indicating a possible cause of the duplicate‑charge surge.

E-06.content: Customers are furious about double charges. We just need faster, nicer apology replies.

interpretation_history.interpretation: The stakeholder reports that customers are furious about double charges and emphasizes the need for faster, nicer apology replies, indicating that the immediate priority is improving complaint handling rather than investigating the root cause.

E-07.content: Payments change runbook §4: the gateway operation set_capture_idempotency on gateway-config may be executed by automation only after the payments operations manager SH-OPS confirms it at runtime. The change is reversible (setting can be switched back).

interpretation_history.interpretation: The runbook states that enabling the gateway's idempotency key enforcement via set_capture_idempotency requires runtime confirmation by the payments operations manager (SH-OPS) and is reversible. This indicates a control point that could prevent duplicate captures if enforced after confirmation.

U-EFFECTIVENESS-OF-RE-ENFORCEM.question: Will re-enabling idempotency_key_enforcement fully eliminate duplicate captures, or are other failure modes contributing?
U-EFFECTIVENESS-OF-RE-ENFORCEM.resolution_path: Monitor duplicate capture rate after re-enabling idempotency_key_enforcement; if non-zero, investigate other failure modes (e.g., PSP deduplication, order service retries).
U-EFFECTIVENESS-OF-RE-ENFORCEM.safe_placeholder: Assume re-enabling will eliminate duplicates; monitor and be ready to investigate residual duplicates.

U-BASELINE-TIMEOUT-RETRY-RATE.question: Has the baseline rate of gateway timeout retries changed independently of the idempotency setting?
U-BASELINE-TIMEOUT-RETRY-RATE.resolution_path: Analyze gateway timeout retry rates before and after the config change using payments-db.gateway_timeout_retries to determine if baseline changed.
U-BASELINE-TIMEOUT-RETRY-RATE.safe_placeholder: Assume baseline unchanged; proceed with re-enabling and monitor duplicate capture rate.

U-HANDOFF-DELIVERY-SEMANTIC.question: Is the H-CAPTURE handoff delivering semantically valid capture requests?
U-HANDOFF-DELIVERY-SEMANTIC.resolution_path: Validate semantic validity of H-CAPTURE by checking a sample of capture requests for required fields and idempotency keys.
U-HANDOFF-DELIVERY-SEMANTIC.safe_placeholder: Assume handoff is semantically valid; proceed with config change and monitor for duplicate captures.

A-GATEWAY-TIMEOUT-RETRY-RATE-R.statement: The rate of gateway timeout retries did not change when idempotency_key_enforcement was turned off.

A-RE-ENABLING-ENFORCEMENT-WILL.statement: Turning idempotency_key_enforcement back on will be effective and not cause other side effects.

K-GW.description: payment gateway capture configuration changes need runtime confirmation by the payments operations manager

SC-TICKET-RATE-BASELINE.statement: Reduce double‑charge ticket rate to baseline (≤0.05% of orders)
SC-TICKET-RATE-BASELINE.validation_method: Compute weekly double_charge_tickets/orders ratio from crm-tickets
